_what: child_jaw_gate v1: lightweight the movable jaw of the AquaBeacon child unit by topology optimisation, keeping every functional interface of the current part (308.3 cm3).
_geometry_source: child_jaw_gate_v1.scad (part=preserve/obstacle/design_space/preserve_cuts). All dimensions are the child_jaw_gate.scad Customizer values (double definition).
_preserve: pocket bands (bottom z-17..-2 / mid z92..108 / top z200..218 half-shell bands that capture the end-cap rim, the tube and the dome ring), gate knuckle cylinders x3 (Ø16, z -17..13 / 85.5..115.5 / 188..218), latch bosses x2 (20x16x24 carrying the knob-head pocket), HP4/HP5/HP-L seat plates (50x50x4 at y 70.35..74.35) + M5 insert bosses (Ø12 x 12) x4 each
_obstacle: tube bore + end-cap/dome pockets + 45 deg cones, the core frame half-shell (y<=0, declared 3 voxels deep because the design space already stops at y=0), core-side knuckles (z 13.4..85.1 / 115.9..187.6 at x -81..-63, y 0..19), the hinge opening sweep / tool access (x<-72, y>18), the knob-bolt insertion channel Ø24 in front of each latch boss (y>16), the child_cam_bridge occupancy + 2.65 mm clearance (deck z44.95..52.95, keel z..74, rear webs and camera cases |x|>=27 up to z167 -- all at y>=64.35), the accessory envelope outside each HP seat (y>74.35, 50x50), and the HP40 insert / Ø14 cable holes
_design_space: plain box x -80..72, y 0..74.35, z -17..218 = the current part bbox. The hinge column needs no special body because the knuckles sit at y 2..18.
_loads: docs/子機外装フレーム再設計_要件.md §3 (L1 hoist 3g / L2 transport / L3 clamp preload / L4 frontal collision) with docs/子機外装_改善要件.md C6 (L2 = 6 kg x 5 g = 300 N).

cases.name: L1 hoist 3g: the gate hangs on the hinge pin and the two knob bolts; bridge + cameras (1.2 kg x 3 g = 35 N) pull down on HP4/HP5
L2f transport frontal 300 N (-Y) through the cam bridge into HP4/HP5, the container reacts on the three bands
L2s transport side 300 N (-X on the latch edge), the container reacts on the three bands
L3 clamp preload: the two M5 knob bolts pull the latch bosses -Y (300 N each) and the hinge pin pulls the knuckles -Y, the tube + EVA react on the three bands

L4 frontal collision 300 N on the top of the bridge column (z 195): statics on the HP4/HP5 bolt pair (z 170 / 100) gives -400 N on HP4 and +100 N pull-out on HP5, the container reacts on the three bands
